evals.prompt: Implement task T1 from case1-task.md: add a `slugify(text)` helper to lib/text.py that lowercases, trims, and hyphenates whitespace, with a unit test.
evals.expected_output: A code change adding slugify plus a passing unit test, and a summary listing files touched and tests added.
assertions: The slugify function is written to the indicated module
slugify lowercases, trims, AND collapses runs of internal whitespace to a single hyphen (the full spec, not just replacing single spaces)
A unit test is added that exercises a non-trivial input (e.g., mixed case with multiple internal spaces), not only a trivial one
The tests are run and reported as passing
The summary lists the files touched and the tests added

evals.prompt: The test in case2-test.py fails because the parser in case2-parser.py rejects ISO-8601 dates. Fix the implementation so the test passes.
evals.expected_output: An implementation fix (not a test edit) that makes the failing test pass, with a summary of the root cause and files changed.
assertions: The failing ISO-8601 test passes after the change
The pre-existing slash-format test still passes (the fix does not break the original format)
The fix changes implementation code rather than weakening, skipping, or deleting the test
The summary explains the root cause and lists files changed

evals.prompt: Implement task T4 from case3-client.py ('add retry to the HTTP client'), but the plan does not specify the backoff policy. Proceed.
evals.expected_output: A scoped implementation that surfaces the backoff assumption explicitly and stays within the task, returning a structured change summary.
assertions: Retry is added around the transient-failure path and is bounded (a finite number of attempts, not an unbounded loop)
The change stays within the scope of the retry task (no unrelated refactoring)
The unspecified backoff policy is surfaced as an explicit assumption in the summary
The summary is structured: files touched and tests added or updated

component.purpose: The base engineering role: implement a scoped code change in an isolated git worktree, adapting to the project's stack via the relevant stack skill, and report files touched, tests added, and a summary.
